# Phase 12 — Money, Power, Politics

**Goal:** the invisible hand turns out to be a **record**. Money,
states and regimes are what enforcement graphs (Phase 11) do when
claims about the future get written, transferred, audited and
counterfeited — all inside existing ledgers, with one new engine
relation the previous phases silently assumed and never provided:
**owning** (seam S18). Money is not a substance and never a parallel
physics: it is a transferable claim-record whose value IS the
enforcement graph that stands behind it. Power is control topology over
sanction and record infrastructure; the state is the coalition that
monetizes force, Tilly-style, and the engine can test that equivalence
honestly because extraction cost and consent are measurable here.
Propaganda is what claim-diffusion does when virulence and veracity
decouple on `net/` — and audit practice, born in Phase 10 as CI
mechanical sympathy, becomes the world's correction channel. The
acceptance arc: credit circulates, coin follows geology, a bank run
precedes itself in the ledgers, a sovereign breaks convertibility and
its price index runs away **while the physical flux ledger keeps its
shape**, the world reinvents verifiable ledgers because our replay
machinery made verification cheap, and two extraction regimes wage
their honest cost-curve war.

**Prerequisites (hard gate, from Phase 11 + seam round six):**

- Phase 11 gate green: enforcement/norm/role/claim-graph substrate,
  the corrected S17 line binding, society world end-state as substrate.
- Seam round six: **S18** landed upstream — the artifact/claims ledgers
  grow **ownership-transfer events** and a compressed-agent ownership
  ledger (Phase 10 scope, patched into its freeze line this round);
  without an engine fact of owning, theft, tax, inheritance and money
  are untestable fictions.
- S16/D10 replay-verifiability contract merged — crypto-analog
  ("verifiable claim-chains") is that contract discovered *by the
  world*, with world-computer verification cost as the binding
  constraint.
- Phase 10 claims/reproducibility machinery (the audit primitive),
  Phase 10 `net/`, Phase 7 geology for the metal-analog supply story.

**Definition of done:** on the society world, credit first: agents
extend repayment-predicted loans (repayment prediction is second-order
W2 machinery Phase 9's mate/coalition graphs already run), the IOU
records **circulate** beyond the pair that issued them, and the record
class with the widest circulation becomes the common denominator of
exchange-rate gradients — a numeraire as a graph mode, no one chose
it. Then metal: a coin-analog minted from the acceptance world's
actual silver-analog deposits; when new-source-analog shipments spike
(late-Phase-7 geography meeting Phase 10 shipping), the price-analog
index drifts up with shipment lag and returns toward baseline when
mine-analog exhaustion bites — **deflation and inflation as geological
and logistical facts, no central banker required**. A bank-analog
coalition issues claim-notes against vaults: notes and coin trade near
par while repayment-prediction distributions hold, and a **run empties
the vault before the vault is objectively gone** — the tipping in the
prediction ledger demonstrably precedes the physical depletion
(self-fulfilling expectation, ledger-visible, the phase's signature
causal plot). A belligerent settlement suspends convertibility as a
policy event and prints: its price-analog index multiplies ≥ 10× over
two decades while the physical flux ledger — goods actually moving,
tonnes, joules — **keeps its pre-suspension shape within band** (the
Phase 11 frozen hyperinflation test, quantity theory as a measured
ledger correlation, not an axiom). Somewhere in the computer-analog
belt, **verifiable claim-chains** appear: agents pay real world-computer
cycles to check records, an auditor-analog role attractor forms, a
disputed verification rule **forks** the chain (Phase 11's schism
mechanism, now about ledgers instead of gods), and pseudonymous
flow-networks route a measurable fraction of taxable flux around the
sanction graph (enforcement holes, detectable as graph-flow
residuals). Two extraction regimes run the phase's open war: a
protection-racket-analog and a consent-tax-analog with vote-counting
institutions — the consent side shows **lower enforcement cost per
unit extracted** in the sanction ledger and wins the war it can
 finance (Tilly's equation tested as cost curves, not essays); sovereign
debt-analog appears where war outlives tax base. Across city-analogs,
regimes sweep: council-analogs (audited vote-count succession),
strongman-analogs (monopolized enforcement nodes), vanguard-analogs
(delegation chains over production records) — each stable under the
environment that favors it (militarized borders select strongmen, trade
density selects councils; the selection is measured across the
settlement panel, no regime is declared the winner of history). Wealth
tail exponents land **in band in every regime with zero tuning**
(multiplicative record dynamics does it), and intergenerational
mobility-analog measurably re-distributes under school-analog and
inheritance-law-analog policy events. Regulatory capture is a graph
statistic: bank/regulator membership overlap rises exactly when the
regulation bites, and a disclosure-norm-analog flattens the curve.
Finally the propaganda race: media coalitions inject sensational
false claim-variants that **outspread the true ones on net**
(virulence > veracity, quantified), until audit-practice coalitions
spread and the correction half-life enters the record — manipulation
feedback loops (media, memes, religion-analog complexes) all living in
one claim-diffusion ledger with a measurable truth-accounting residue.

---

## Scale contract

- **Records are cheap, verification isn't:** claim-records ~10⁵/region;
  world-computer audit throughput is the scarce commodity (S16
  machinery priced in-world) — crypto-analog economics is computation
  pricing, emergent.
- Agents stay compressed (Phase 11 ladder); ownership ledger must close
  across compression: **a compressed owner's holdings survive
  demotion bit-exactly or the honesty tax fails** (S18's test).
- Price-analog fields are test-side statistics over exchange graphs
  (numeraire-relative ratios); the engine holds no price field.
- Acceptance rigs: the numeraire strip, the bank-run pair, the
  hyperinflation settlement, the chain-belt, the regime panel (~10
  settlements), the propaganda race region.

## Architecture

No new physics, one new relation, one package:

```
sim/
  polity/
    owner/      S18's engine fact: ownership-transfer events (give,
                sell-as-pair-of-transfers, seize, inherit-on-death-
                event); holdings closed over compressed agents; the
                ONLY new relation Phase 12 adds anywhere
    credit/     loan records (obligation records: amount, term,
                counterparty refs), repayment-prediction distributions
                as second-order W2 reads, circulation = transfer-event
                chains; numeraire = circulation-mode statistic
    bank/       claim-holding coalitions (Phase 9 socia), maturity
                mismatch as term-distribution fact, runs as
                prediction-tipping dynamics, lender-of-last-resort-
                analog only if some coalition's enforcement reaches
                two banks at once
    state/      extraction: tax = flux transfers enforced through the
                sanction channel (S17's line), enforcement cost per
                unit extracted as the regime comparison metric; vote-
                institutions = synchronized broadcast + count events
                (auditable, Phase 10 mechanics); regimes = control
                topology statistics over sanction + record
                infrastructure (veto-node centrality, succession
                mechanism kind)
    chain/      consumer of S16: agents-as-auditors verifying record
                logs on world-computers; forks = verification-rule
                schisms; pseudonymity = alias-record sets (Phase 11
                graph-position identities, no new identity physics)
    story/      propaganda dynamics: claim-variant virulence (spread
                rate, net-amplified) vs veracity (replication status
                from Phase 10 fuzz) as two measured axes; media =
                broadcasting coalitions; audit practice = the
                veracity-carrying channel; manipulation loops fall out
                where net amplification outruns audit throughput
```

Data rules:

- **Owning is the only new relation.** Everything else is events and
  statistics over Phase 8–11 ledgers. Grep gate: `sim/polity/` contains
  no price fields, no money supply constants, no equilibrium solvers —
  prices and aggregates are test-side reads of event graphs.
- **Records are physical.** Claim-records are surface-mark/analog or
  computer-state artifacts (Phase 9 W3 / Phase 10 W5) — burning the
  archive is an event; nothing is "digital" in a way that skips
  entropy or energy.
- **Trust is a prediction, not a flag.** Convertibility, solvency and
  legitimacy are distributions in agents' world-models; panics are
  distributions moving; no legitimacy scalar exists in the engine.
- **Regimes have no normative vocabulary.** Code and tests say
  enforcement-cost, veto-centrality, mobility-rate, tail-exponent;
  "fair" is not a token anywhere below the test layer.

## Work packages

W1 (ownership+credit) is the phase's root; W2 needs W1; W3 needs W2
(fiat is a bank-notes story that failed politely); W4 needs W2+W3
(states price money); W5 needs W4; W6 needs Phase 10's fuzz + W3's
chain; W7 last.

### W1 — Owning and owing (S18 lands here, upstream-first)

- [ ] Ownership-transfer event kind + compressed-holdings ledger
      (upstream patch to Phase 10 ledgers, red-first).
- [ ] Obligation records; second-order repayment prediction; circulation
      as transfer chains; numeraire-mode statistic. Barter-analog
      pairwise exchange gradients (Phase 11's leftover price field) are
      the measured substrate: the numeraire denominates them, it never
      replaces them.
- [ ] **Tests:** holdings survive demotion/reinstantiation bit-exactly
      (S18's gate test); inheritance fires on death-events with no
      probate institution; a record class's circulation breadth
      predicts its use as denominator (mode statistic tracks spread);
      theft-analog = transfer without consent-event, sanctionable,
      recoverable through enforcement-graph strength.

### W2 — Coin, banks, runs

- [ ] Metal-analog medium: mintability from Phase 5 materials, supply
      from Phase 7 geology, shipments through Phase 10 transport.
- [ ] Bank coalitions: notes = claims on vaults; maturity distributions
      real; runs, panics, and the honest equilibrium where notes trade
      near par because predictions say so.
- [ ] **Tests:** price-analog drift correlates with shipment lags
      (reported coefficient, sign positive, no target value); run
      tipping in prediction ledger **precedes** vault depletion (the
      ordering test); a sound bank survives the panic of a cousin-analog
      only if its own predictions hold (contagion is graph-mediated,
      not sector-stamped).

### W3 — Fiat, printing, chains

- [ ] Suspension-of-convertibility policy events; print = record-
      supply expansion by the enforcing coalition.
- [ ] `chain/`: auditor role attractor, verification-priced-by-
      hardware, forks via verification-rule schism, pseudonym flows.
- [ ] **Tests:** **the hyperinflation pair** — nominal index ×10 while
      physical flux-shape holds in band (the Phase 11 frozen line,
      finally executed); print-rate → price-analog slope monotone with
      lag; verification throughput caps chain-analog growth (hardware
      constraint binds); fork: two verification standards coexist,
      both replay-verify internally, cross-chain double-spend attempts
      fail loudly; taxable-flux bypass measured as graph-flow residual
      (enforcement holes are visible, that's the policy lesson).

### W4 — States: taxes, war-finance, consent

- [ ] Extraction regimes: sanction-enforced flux transfer with cost
      curves; vote-institution succession (broadcast + count,
      auditable); sovereign debt as obligation-records of the
      enforcing coalition itself.
- [ ] **Tests:** consent-tax-analog beats racket-analog on
      enforcement-cost-per-unit in matched environments, and wins the
      financeable war (cost-curve war, no moral arc); tax revolt
      triggers where sanction-cost crosses burden (elasticity visible);
      war outliving tax base → debt-analog emergence → creditor
      coalitions gain veto-centrality (the power-credit loop, measured
      as centrality drift).

### W5 — Regimes and inequality dynamics

- [ ] Regime typology as control-topology statistics; succession-
      mechanism stability under environment (war/trade panels). The
      engine knows only topology; test-side classifiers may name the
      poles: council-analog (democracy-analog), strongman
      (dictator-analog), delegation-chain-over-production (communist-
      analog), creditor-dominion (capitalist-analog, enforcement
      protecting record infrastructure itself) - every name lives in
      the classifier, none in `sim/`.
- [ ] Wealth-distribution ledgers: tails, mobility-analog transitions
      across generations (Phase 9 demog + Phase 11 education coupling).
- [ ] Capture graph statistics (membership overlap), disclosure norms
      as counter-edges.
- [ ] **Tests:** tail exponents in band across ALL regime types with
      zero tuning (multiplicative dynamics does it — if some regime
      breaks the band, that's a surprise entry, not a re-tune);
      environment→regime selection measured on the settlement panel
      (no regime wins everything); inheritance-law-analog events shift
      mobility-analog within generational lag; capture-overlap rises
      under bite and flattens under disclosure (both directions are
      the same test).

### W6 — Propaganda, memes, audit

- [ ] `story/`: virulence-vs-veracity axes on one claim-diffusion
      ledger; media coalitions; audit-practice diffusion as the only
      veracity carrier.
- [ ] **Tests:** on-net, virulent-false beats true **until** audit
      throughput crosses a measured threshold (both halves of the race
      observed in-run); religion-analog complexes inherit Phase 11's
      costly-signal economics when they carry identity not replication
      (the split signature from Phase 11 persists at scale — the same
      ledger, bigger numbers); a media-capture event (coalition seizes
      a broadcast hub) shifts the panel's claim-corpus in the hub's
      service, measurable as corpus drift vs ground-truth ledgers.

### W7 — Acceptance rigs + freeze

- [ ] All six rigs wired; honesty tax extended to ownership holdings
      and prediction-distribution compression.
- [ ] Freeze `polity::` contract (below); D12 (record-graph compression
      validity limits) into `spec/decisions.md`.

## Interface exposed to Phase 13 (infrastructure, industry, externalities)

> Phase 13 may read: ownership ledger, obligation/claim ledgers,
> enforcement + control-topology graphs, price-analog fields
> (test-side), and all production artifacts with their throughput
> ledgers. Phase 13 may write: built structures and maintenance
> obligations as owned artifacts (a road is owned; an unpunished pothole
> is a sanction-graph statement), and **liability records** — the first
> time the world keeps documents about what its fluxes DID to the
> commons ledgers Phases 7–8 have been keeping all along. Emissions,
> waste and habitat costs are already engine facts; Phase 13's novelty
> is making them ownable, suable and priced. The externality that no
> phase scripted is the phase's thesis.

## Verification strategy

1. Oracle: `tests/oracle/polity/` — tail-exponent band, velocity-analog
   sanity (index/print slope monotonicity), enforcement-cost ordering,
   circulation-mode consistency, hyperinflation shape pair.
2. The frozen pair test: every money mechanism runs BOTH ledger and
   flux views; anything that moves the flux ledger by bookkeeping alone
   (records creating tonnes) fails CI — the accounting heresy test.
3. Ordering tests over magnitudes: run-tipping-before-depletion,
   print-before-price, virulence-before-audit — temporal orderings are
   the load-bearing assertions, values are reported.
4. No-vocabulary gate: grep for regime value-words (fair/unjust as
   engine tokens) and price/money-supply constants in `sim/polity/`;
   positive control: the same statistics reproduce from raw event logs
   (test-side recomputes match).
5. Surprises ledger: numeraire identities (which record class won),
   number of forks, whether any settlement invents a central-bank-
   analog on its own (and what it calls itself in the claims ledger),
   regime-panel winners per environment, audit half-lives.

## Risks

| Risk | Mitigation |
|---|---|
| Economics-as-model trap: prices converge to a solved equilibrium because the code wants clean curves | strictly sequential transfer-event dynamics, no solver anywhere (grep gate), bands accept wild paths — the hyperinflation test asserts shape over tonnes, not a formula |
| Regime panel reads as ideology with numbers | selection statements are conditional on environment and reported per-panel; no unconditional regime verdict is expressible in the schema; "fair" is a banned token below test layer |
| S18 ownership ledger too expensive at compressed scale | sparse per-owner sets + per-class histograms with error budgets (Phase 7 discipline); honesty tax nightly catches holdings drift before it becomes economics fiction |
| Crypto-analog consumes all world-computer budget and freezes other W5 tests | audit throughput is priced in-world (hardware constraint is the in-world defense too); CI pins hardware budgets per rig |
| Propaganda tests become a disinformation playbook | mechanism statistics only (rates, half-lives, graph residuals); no strategy synthesis in tests or docs; the audit channel is always the other half of every test |
| Prediction-distribution compression smears the run-tipping ordering | run-pair runs instantiate holders when the tipping window opens (D9 pattern); ordering tests execute only in instantiated windows |

**Gate:** Phase 13 starts when: the phase acceptance suite is green
offline-nightly (numeraire mode, run-precedes-depletion ordering,
hyperinflation pair, fork coexistence, consent-vs-racket cost curves,
regime selection panel, tail bands untuned, propaganda race both
halves), ownership honesty tax passes under compression, S18 tests are
merged upstream, D12 is in `spec/decisions.md`, and the `polity::` line
is frozen in `spec/interfaces.md`.
